title: KY-038 awaaz nahi, sirf shor pehchanta hai 🎤 #shorts
description:
Sound sensor ko log 'voice sensor' bolte hain, par ye awaaz nahi pehchanta.
Sirf itna dekhta hai ki shor aapke set kiye level se zyada hai ya nahi.
🎤 Electret mic aur LM393 comparator ka kaam
📈 AO pin: level trend, DO pin: threshold
🔧 Pot se sensitivity set karna
⚡ 3.3–5 V supply, 4 pins

Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ko, aur roz ek module kholke dekho!
